answers.answer: The Platform team owns the orbit-gateway service that sends SSE heartbeats, led by Tomás Ortega [C2][C3].
Priya Shah was the incident commander for ORB-2291 [C5]. She belongs to the SRE team, which has a weekly primary rotation led by Daniel Okafor [C1][C4].
The mxbai-embed-large model produces embeddings [C1], owned by the Platform team (Embedding Service) led by Tomás Ortega [C4].
Phase I steps in the Deal Filter Pipeline are: 1) Intent Classification (`_classify_intent`), 2) Query Decomposition (`_decompose_query`), and 3) Runner Fan-out (`_run_sub_queries`) [C4][C6].
Concurrent sub-queries from the runner fan-out reached the Deal Filter Runner simultaneously, causing multiple CRM logins to race and corrupt the SDK's shared cache [C2].
